title: Shipping Rate Structure
description: Field-by-field structural documentation for a shipping rate quote on the Shipping.com marketplace platform

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for this rate quote, assigned by Shipping.com when the rate is published or queried.

fields.name: carrierId
fields.description: Unique identifier of the ocean carrier or freight forwarder providing this rate.

fields.name: carrierName
fields.description: Human-readable name of the carrier (e.g., Maersk, MSC, CMA CGM, Evergreen).

fields.name: serviceLevel
fields.description: Shipping service type. FCL = Full Container Load, LCL = Less than Container Load, RoRo = Roll-on Roll-off.

fields.name: origin
fields.description: Origin port or shipping location with UN/LOCODE identifier.

fields.name: unlocode
fields.description: UN/LOCODE port identifier (5-character code, e.g., USLAX, CNSHA, DEHAM)

fields.name: name
fields.description: Human-readable port name (e.g., Los Angeles, Shanghai, Hamburg)

fields.name: country
fields.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g., US, CN, DE)

fields.name: region
fields.description: Geographic trade region (e.g., North America, Asia Pacific, Europe)

fields.name: destination
fields.description: Destination port or shipping location.

fields.name: unlocode
fields.description: UN/LOCODE port identifier

fields.name: name
fields.description: Human-readable port name

fields.name: country
fields.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code

fields.name: region
fields.description: Geographic trade region

fields.name: rate
fields.description: Base freight rate amount, currency, and pricing unit.

fields.name: amount
fields.description: Numeric rate amount (e.g., 1200.00 for $1,200 per TEU)

fields.name: currency
fields.description: ISO 4217 currency code. Most ocean freight rates are denominated in USD.

fields.name: unit
fields.description: Pricing unit: per-TEU (20ft container), per-FEU (40ft container), per-ton, per-cbm, per-shipment, or per-kg

fields.name: validFrom
fields.description: ISO 8601 date from which this rate becomes effective (e.g., 2024-01-01).

fields.name: validTo
fields.description: ISO 8601 date until which this rate is valid (e.g., 2024-03-31). Rates may be updated quarterly or monthly.

fields.name: transitTime
fields.description: Estimated transit time in calendar days from origin port to destination port.

fields.name: sailingFrequency
fields.description: How often the carrier operates this service (e.g., Weekly, Bi-weekly, Monthly).

fields.name: surcharges
fields.description: Array of additional surcharges on top of the base freight rate. Common surcharges include BAF (Bunker Adjustment Factor), PSS (Peak Season Surcharge), GRI (General Rate Increase), and THC (Terminal Handling Charges).

items.name: unit
items.description: Unit of measurement for this surcharge

fields.name: commodity
fields.description: Commodity type or cargo description this rate applies to (e.g., General Cargo, Electronics, Chemicals).

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this rate was published to the Shipping.com marketplace.
